desc: 花瓣边翻领女童短袖针织衫，暖光柠檬篷檐首屏加全空号型信息层
leaf: 女童花瓣边翻领短袖针织上衣（三粒扣门襟，配牛仔下装与遮阳篷檐渔夫帽外穿）
name: 女童花瓣翻领三粒扣短袖针织衫款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里先看清这是一件花瓣边翻领短袖而不是一件圆领T恤，无身体的立版单品满足白底主图合规并抢点击。
首屏一秒法则：把源页的遮阳篷檐与紫卡标题结构复用到上传产品上，一次讲完头号利益，同时用颈部以下裁切规避童模面容。
shots.textZone: one headline slot and one subline slot inside the violet block, one coral outlined pill slot beneath them

shots.intent: 把源页的舒适透气口号翻回夏天童装两个真实摩擦：汗后肩缝湿印贴背、洗后领口起翘翻不平，右格再交出版型与领座解法。
shots.textZone: one short label slot centred under each panel

shots.intent: 把这件上衣最贵的结构差别做成可核对的视觉证据：同一侧姿下领座立得住与软塌贴颈的对照，胜过任何柔软口号。
shots.textZone: one label slot above each garment and one headline slot on the violet strip

shots.intent: 用最便宜的成本换最强的做工信任：领边扇形牙口、门襟与第一粒扣在肩缝处的断点一次看清，替掉所有空洞面料话术。
shots.textZone: one caption slot at the lower right

shots.intent: 复现源页的机制解释屏但改掉其功效词面：一块织面剖面加三枚无字线章，把结构讲成可见证据，指标词一律留给卖家填。
shots.textZone: one header slot on the violet strip and one blank caption slot beneath each of the three tiles

shots.intent: 回答会不会卷边和卡胳膊：袖口回折量与下摆双针车线一屏看清，是全库少见的袖口特写角色。
shots.textZone: one label slot under each crop

shots.intent: 复现源页唯一的户外实拍屏：暖低光加虚化绿篱给出穿着情绪，但画面里始终有大人同框、孩子不入镜面容也不做危险动作。
shots.textZone: one caption chip on the plate edge

shots.intent: 替家长回答买大买小与厚薄版型：照搬源页的参数行加四档指示条加分列表结构，但每一格与每一个档位词都留空由卖家真实数据填。
shots.textZone: one header slot, five blank parameter rows, one fully empty banded table grid and four blank indicator rails with unlabelled steps

shots.intent: 把源页那组未加载的粉色空窗还原成可用结构：三件同尺度挂装加三个空白色名位，色档一律取自参考图，选色一步到位。
shots.textZone: one short blank colour-label slot centred under each frame

shots.intent: 第三处做工证据：正俯微距把织面纱粒与门襟断点摊在纸板上，补上侧面光看不到的平整度信息。
shots.textZone: one caption slot at the lower left

shots.intent: 收口只给动作位：把源页的会员角标与整块二维码换成紫display块加一枚票券纸描边按钮，不带任何价格与优惠事实。
shots.textZone: one headline slot on the violet block plus one outlined rectangular button slot on the coupon band

style.backgroundSystem: printed graph-paper field #F5E7D3 carrying hairline grid rules that stay square to the frame, always crowned by one scalloped awning valance band #F3C13B across the top edge of an infographic screen; one grape-violet display block #5C3B93 carrying a ticket notch on each side used for section headers and for the closing screen; pale paper step #FAF1E4 used for cards and the coupon band; coral #E06A55 used only as hairline rules, tile outlines and one header row, never as a full field; exactly one out-of-focus hedge band #6E7F5B over a pale paving strip #E8DCC8 is sanctioned, and only inside the single worn lifestyle screen; never a gradient, never a furnished interior, never a street scene, never a hue outside this list
style.direction: warm lemonade-stand children's summer knitwear commerce, scalloped awning valance over printed graph paper, ticket-notched display blocks and a soft orchard-light scene
style.iconSystem: abstract single-weight pictograms in coral #E06A55 seated inside small rounded-square tiles outlined twice in ink-violet #2E2340 on a pale paper card #FAF1E4, each tile paired with one dotted underline rule; the only other decorative shapes allowed are the scalloped awning valance #F3C13B, one dotted arc and one ticket notch punched into the edge of a violet block; no ring medallions, no punched-centre discs, no shields, no crests, no hexagons, no diamonds, no crown or sparkle doodles, no checkmark seals, no certificate plates, no mascot faces and no QR artwork
style.lightingSystem: warm high-key studio light at 5000K entering from the upper RIGHT, so every honest directional shadow lies to the left and a true contact shadow sits under each hem, card edge and folded stack; large paper bounce fill on the shadow side; inside the macro screens the same key turns into warm raking light grazing from the right edge with falloff to the left; the single lifestyle screen uses low sun at 4500K from the upper right with dappled leaf shadow on the paving and a 5000K bounce in the collar zone; no cool cast, no frontal airless flash, no rim flash, no blown specular hotspot
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm lemonade-stand children's summer knitwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of printed graph-paper cream #F5E7D3, palest paper step #FAF1E4, awning yellow #F3C13B, grape-violet display block #5C3B93 and ink-violet type #2E2340, with coral #E06A55 as the single accent reserved for hairlines, tile outlines and one table header row, plus one product-matched accent supplied at generation time as {accent_color}; layout grammar limited to the scalloped awning valance, the ticket-notched violet block, a dotted arc, a perforated coupon band, coral hairline rules, banded table rows with every cell left blank, four blank indicator rails with unlabelled steps, coral line pictograms inside rounded-square tiles and one outlined rectangular button slot, with no ring medallion, no punched-centre disc, no shield, no hexagon or diamond cell, no crown or sparkle doodle, no checkmark seal, no certificate plate, no mascot face and no QR artwork; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

style.presentationRules: the collared short-sleeve knit top stays the hero at one scale across the set, never shifting more than five percent between screens; the denim bottom and the sun hat never become the subject and appear only as styling at the frame edge; every worn frame is a generic child body cropped from the neck down or below the shoulders, eyes always out of frame, and the child is never shown unaccompanied, never climbing and never mid-run; the scalloped collar edge, the buttoned placket stand, the turned-back sleeve cuffs and the hem line are named structurally, kept square-on and never redrawn; any chest or print zone stays a blank slot; hung and packshot frames rest on an invisible air form so shoulders keep their natural shape
style.surfaceSystem: matte printed graph paper #F5E7D3 as the print plane of every layout block, pale paper card #FAF1E4 under tables and rails, violet board #5C3B93 behind the coupon band and the closing window, matte paper under the macro crops; on the lifestyle screen a pale paving strip #E8DCC8 underfoot; garment faces stay flat, unwrinkled and lint-free with the scalloped collar points lying square and the sleeve turn-backs symmetric, no dust, no floor debris, no furniture
style.typography: one heavy rounded geometric sans-serif for every Chinese and Latin label, headlines set in the same family at its heaviest weight with a wide-tracked Latin companion line in the same family; in-image copy is only ever carried as selling-point and callout placeholders inside corner brackets, one headline slot and one subline slot per screen; headline 28-44pt, subline 15-18pt, label 11-13pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters; no brush lettering, no script, no serif, no oversized outlined display word, no pinyin display line, no rendered numerals and no filled-in body paragraph
